analysis: post-hoc supplementary binary case-control; not primary right-reason analysis

definitions.negative: observed-fixed resolved composition plus warning-only broken composition
definitions.prediction: actual reject flag, otherwise rejection state or nonempty findings; cause irrelevant
definitions.not_supported: no finding means negative prediction, not an abstention; retained rejection/finding means positive
definitions.complete_case: exclude a composition from every method if any method is unassessable
definitions.undefined: null iff the corresponding ratio denominator is zero
definitions.inference: artificial case-control prevalence, not deployed precision; compositions from one case may be dependent
